comingLast.roast: a 2-marker at the bottom - the members' board did not see this coming
the escape hatch: 7 points in 5 holes - all downhill from here, hopefully not literally
at 1.3 a hole the blue balls fit like they were measured for him
6 points buys freedom - Johnson is pricing it higher by the minute
escape requires 2 over the last 3 - his mates have started filming
3 more points and the problem becomes Johnson's problem
in on 1 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
finished 3 clear of the blue balls - now buying Johnson drinks out of gratitude
in the clubhouse 4 above Johnson - cheering for him from a safe distance
